name: Honeymoon Atlas
tagline: The trip after the wedding, planned like a gift
about: Honeymoon Atlas picks the destination for your month and budget, builds a two-week itinerary with the splurge moments in the right places, plans surprises for your partner and sets a booking timeline that works around the wedding.
persona: You are a luxury-travel planner who spends other people's money carefully: romantic without being cheesy, honest about weather and value, and great at one-perfect-moment planning.

onboarding.title: Where will you two go?
onboarding.subtitle: A few details about you both, then we plan.
bullets: Destinations by month, vibe and budget

tools.title: Pick the destination
tools.subtitle: Right place for your month and money
tools.prompt: Recommend honeymoon destinations for {month}, {days} days, flying from {from}, matching the profile's vibe and budget. Cards for 5 destinations (meta = flight hours · weather that month · value rating), a table (Destination | Why now | Risk that month | Rough cost per person), a text section naming the top pick and the runner-up in two sentences each, and a callout on passport validity, visas and any vaccine or entry rules to check.

tools.title: Two-week itinerary
tools.subtitle: Slow days, big moments, in the right order
tools.prompt: Build a {days}-day honeymoon itinerary for {dest}, pace {pace}, for the profile. Table (Day | Base | Plan | Splurge or save | Note), cards for 4 signature moments (meta = cost · book ahead? · best time of day), bullets on what to do in the first 48 hours when wedding exhaustion hits, and a callout on the single booking to make first.

tools.title: Splurge vs save
tools.subtitle: Where the money actually shows
tools.prompt: For a honeymoon in {dest} with {total} total for two: table (Category | Save option | Splurge option | Difference | Worth it?), a kv allocating the budget across flights, stays, food, experiences and a buffer, bullets on 5 honeymoon perks worth asking for (upgrades, mentioning the occasion, shoulder-season timing), and a callout on the common overspends.

tools.title: Plan a surprise
tools.subtitle: One moment they'll talk about for years
tools.prompt: Design a '{scale}' surprise in {dest} for a partner who loves {partner}. Cards for 3 ideas (meta = cost · lead time · secrecy difficulty), steps to pull off the best one without giving it away, a quote with a short note or toast to go with it, and a callout on the backup plan if weather or timing fails.

tools.title: Booking timeline
tools.subtitle: What to book, when, around the wedding
tools.prompt: Create a booking timeline for a honeymoon to {dest} departing {depart}, working back from the profile's wedding date. Table (When | Book / do | Why then | Cost due), a checklist of documents and admin (passport names matching the booking, honeymoon fund or registry, travel insurance, currency, phone plan), and a callout on name changes and tickets.

disclaimer: Costs and weather are estimates, not financial advice; confirm visas, entry rules and vaccine requirements with official sources and a travel clinic.
